intent: Compare magnitudes across categories with vertical or horizontal bars.
useWhen: Grouped comparisons with categories plus series

tickInterval.note: draw every Nth axis label; with neither tickInterval nor formatLabel, labels thin automatically only when they would overlap

formatLabel.note: (category, index) => string for the painted axis label; return '' to hide one (turns off automatic thinning). Table and accessible names keep the raw category

animate.note: Bars grow from the zero line (negative values grow downward, horizontal bars sideways) with a short stagger when they first appear. Runs once on mount; data changes do not replay it. Off under prefers-reduced-motion

requirements: Bars expose category and value in accessible names
Repeated category labels each keep their own bar and table row
Too many categories for the width: the plot scrolls sideways in a focusable, named region with the value axis pinned
animate is decorative only: no motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and hover, focus, legend and table work during the entrance

doNot: Do not invent chart container cousins
snippet: <BarChart title="Revenue by region" data={[{ label: 'North', value: 2610 }]} />
